comment.body:
Thanks for attaching the diagnostic archive. It shows both non-elevated and elevated PowerToys activity, but only one final settings snapshot, so it cannot tell whether Windows switched user profiles or when a setting changed. Please provide:

- Whether the UAC prompt was approved with the same Windows account that originally configured PowerToys; do not include account names.
- Using that same account, choose one visible non-default setting and record its value plus `is_elevated` and `run_elevated` before and after **Restart as administrator** and one reboot.
- If the value changes, add a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately after that transition.

This comparison will separate expected per-user configuration isolation from an elevation, startup, or persistence defect.
